title: Full SAT Math Module Walkthrough: 22 Questions, Explained
description:
A full-length SAT math module: 22 questions, 35 minutes, easiest to hardest, in roughly the same proportions as the real test (algebra, advanced math, problem-solving and data analysis, geometry and trig). Pause, take it timed, then watch every question solved, with Desmos shortcuts where they save time. At the end, score yourself by domain and see what to review.

Covered:
• Linear equations, systems, inequalities, and linear models
• Quadratics, vertex form, exponential models, rational equations, and function transformations
• Percentages, conditional probability, and mean/median
• Triangles, right-triangle trig, and a tangent line to a circle
• How to enter student-produced response answers (fractions, decimals, negatives)

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank.
